posts.name: Pruve.dev
posts.tagline: Ask any line of code why it exists, and get receipts
posts.description: AI writes the code, then throws the reasoning away at merge: the thread, the issue, the agent session. Pruve reads a repository's history and answers why any line is the way it is, with receipts you can open. No evidence, no answer. Free for open source repositories.

posts.name: Handled Locator
posts.tagline: Store locator software, styled to match your site
posts.description: Store locator widget you embed with one line of script. Customize to fully match your brand, with map usage billed directly by your chosen provider.

posts.name: Roleward (Candidate Background)
posts.tagline: Stop paying $30/mo for hallucinated AI resume scores
posts.description: An open-source style Claude Skill & Notion workflow that acts as a strict, fact-based career interviewer. It stops LLMs from hallucinating metrics, audits your real positioning fit for target roles, and formats your verified experience into a clean Notion Master CV database. No paywalls, no fake scores — just clean facts.

posts.name: Miyu Paint
posts.tagline: Native layered image editing for Mac, without the clutter
posts.description: Miyu Paint is a native, layered image editor for Mac built for quick edits without a heavyweight studio workflow. Draw, select, resize, add editable text and shapes, use masks and non-destructive adjustment layers, then save layeredmpaint documents or export PNG, JPEG, and TIFF. Everything stays on your Mac: no account, ads, analytics, tracking, or subscription.

posts.name: Chant Counter AI Plus
posts.tagline: Offline voice counting for chanting & japa
posts.description: Chant Counter AI Plus is an Android app designed to make repetitive chanting and japa counting easier without constantly touching the phone. Its main difference is offline voice-based counting: you can place the phone on a table and chant naturally while the app keeps count. It also supports manual counting for users who prefer tapping. The app is designed to work without registration or an internet connection, keeping the experience simple and private.

posts.name: Workshopr.io -The Facilitation Platform
posts.tagline: Plan, run and synthesize workshops in one
posts.description: ▎ Workshopr is one app for the whole arc of a workshop: make the case for it, drag the agenda together, run the room from a live console, then turn what surfaced into a readout you can send. 380+ exercises and 50+ ready-made workshops to pull from. Not five tools with an integration story, one workshop moving through five states. No exports, no re-typing.

posts.name: Kakeibo: Goal & Budget Planner
posts.tagline: The 1904 Japanese budgeting method, now on iPhone
posts.description: Kakeibo is the Japanese household ledger Hani Motoko published in 1904. Four spending categories, one savings promise made before the month starts, four questions answered when it ends. The app does the arithmetic and leaves the reflecting to you. Free tier.

posts.name: culturewar.lol, pay to own a state
posts.tagline: Take a state, fly your flag
posts.description: A live map of the United States where you pay to claim a state and fly your flag over it. Say something loud enough that somebody pays 1.5x to say it differently.

posts.name: TickClip
posts.tagline: The AI shopping assistant that tells you when not to buy
posts.description: Protect your buying decisions, not the transaction. TickClip explains the evidence and recommends Tick, Clip, or Skip without affiliate commissions or paid placement.

posts.name: pomelli
posts.tagline: Create different variations of meta ads with just one URL.
posts.description: Pomelli is a Brand-Consistent AI Ad Generator for Meta & TikTok. Input your product URL, and our AI analyzes selling points to auto-generate diverse ad creatives and variants. Rapidly A/B test to find winning ads and boost sales without manual design.

posts.name: Vibedecode
posts.tagline: Visualize, Analyze and Understand your Code
posts.description: VibeDecode helps you understand the code that AI or you vibed into existence. Visualize your GitHub repository as an interactive animated code graph. Currently supports Python, Typescript and Javascript based codebases.

posts.name: Nerdy — Workout Tracker (No LLM)
posts.tagline: The fitness app for streak lovers. Streaks you can't fake.
posts.description: NERDY turns the thing people already love about streaks into something you actually have to earn. Instead of tapping a button to keep a fitness streak alive, NERDY uses your phone’s camera to count and verify your reps in real time. Squats, push-ups, planks and more become measurable daily challenges — no gym, no equipment, and no manual logging. Our launch is about making fitness feel less like “I should work out” and more like “I can't break my streak.”

posts.name: DevRecall
posts.tagline: On-device memory for everything you ship
posts.description: Most tools that remember your work ship it to someone's cloud. DevRecall keeps a searchable index of your whole work history on your laptop — local SQLite, offline embeddings, nothing leaves the machine. It pulls from Git, GitHub, Slack, Jira, Linear and Confluence, then links each ticket to the commits, PRs and threads that resolved it. Ask "what was that auth bug in February?" and answers cite real rows. Also an MCP server, so Claude Code and Cursor recall your history inline. MIT.

posts.name: PullAtlas
posts.tagline: A calm workspace for worldbuilding and writing fiction.
posts.description: A private manuscript workspace for fiction writers. Chapters, worldbuilding, continuity tracking and serial release scheduling in one place, plus real-time co-writing when you want it. Worldbuilding happens from inside the editor, so a moment of inspiration never sends you hunting through another app. AI is optional, off by default, and bring-your-own-key. Nothing you write trains anything.

posts.name: VibeCopilot
posts.tagline: The all-in-one Unity plugin
posts.description: VibeCopilot is an AI-powered context assistant built directly for Unity. Generate 3D assets in seconds, write and refactor C# code on the fly, and fix console errors with a single click. No more context-switching to external AI tools or hunting down syntax bugs line by line. Keep your workflow inside the editor and build your games 10x faster.

posts.name: Aerostic Automation
posts.tagline: AI-powered automation for growing businesses
posts.description: Aerostic Automation helps businesses automate repetitive work across WhatsApp, CRM, sales, customer support, and follow-ups. Build AI-powered workflows that capture leads, respond to customers, update CRM records, trigger follow-ups, and connect business tools from one platform. Designed for growing businesses that want to reduce manual work and turn more conversations into customers.

posts.name: Price Comparison for Sneakers
posts.tagline: Get the best deal in a few clicks !
posts.description: We are an independent Search Engine and Price Comparison tool for Sneakers and Sports Shoes. Our catalogue consists of +100k Sneakers across +50 merchants in Europe and US. Users can get Price Alerts & Stock alerts for any published sneaker model; we have curated the payment, shipping and return policies of most reliable merchants.

posts.name: Kotoba Forest
posts.tagline: Grow your JLPT vocabulary into a living forest
posts.description: Kotoba Forest turns Japanese vocabulary study into a forest-building game. Start with a 20-question diagnostic, choose a JLPT N5–N1 goal, then plant and water words with spaced repetition. Learn 10,000 words with native audio, example sentences, mock tests, weakness drills, and animal mini-games. Available on iOS and Android with interfaces in English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, and Indonesian.

posts.name: Agnos LLM gateway
posts.tagline: Contain LiteLLM, Bifrost, Portkey.. behind one control plane
posts.description: Agnos is an OpenAI-compatible control plane that wraps the LLM gateway you already run. Keys stay in your encrypted vault (the gateway gets one per request and stores none); you get budgets, guardrails, routing, cost attribution and audit, and you can swap or combine gateways (litellm, bifrost, portkey etc) with a config change. MIT, self-hosted. Live demo, https://agnos-llm-gateway.site https://github.com/siva010928/agnos-proxy-oss
